purpose: Provide soft course-emphasis signals for retrieval and curated study tools without treating the broad syllabus as an exhaustive content boundary.

scope_policy.retrieval_policy: Search the full supplied textbook corpus. Syllabus topic and section mappings may boost ranking but must not exclude other textbook material.
scope_policy.chat_policy: Teach content supported by the supplied Kluever and Schaub & Junkins textbooks. Do not supplement content questions with outside model knowledge; if no reliable textbook section is found, request a chapter/section or textbook terminology instead of answering.
scope_policy.study_tools_policy: Curated flashcards, quizzes, and exam-review lists may remain narrower than conversational help.

course_emphasis: physics and the use of equations in solving problems
two-body analysis and conics as the primary orbital model
analysis of orbital and attitude dynamics and stability

learning_outcomes.label: Describe orbital motion
learning_outcomes.description: Derive equations of motion using appropriate variables and explain the assumptions and approximations involved.

learning_outcomes.label: Estimate orbital parameters
learning_outcomes.description: Use telescope and radar observations to determine orbital parameters in appropriate coordinate frames.

learning_outcomes.label: Control orbit
learning_outcomes.description: Design and implement impulsive maneuvers that change orbital shape, size, and orientation.

learning_outcomes.label: Describe rotational motion
learning_outcomes.description: Analyze free and forced rigid-body rotational dynamics in different coordinate systems.

learning_outcomes.label: Estimate attitude
learning_outcomes.description: Determine spacecraft attitude using inertial- and body-frame sensor observations.

learning_outcomes.label: Control attitude
learning_outcomes.description: Analyze and simulate attitude stabilization and control maneuvers, including reaction-wheel methods.

topics.label: Orbital maneuvers and mission trajectory design
Attitude estimation from vector observations
topics.coverage_note: The supplied textbook chunks do not contain a clearly identified attitude-estimation chapter. Under the textbook-only policy, TYCHO should request an approved chapter or section rather than teach this topic from outside model knowledge.

topics.label: Attitude dynamics, stability, and reaction-wheel control
Non-Keplerian motion
